segments.sn20.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn20.9:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
segments.sn20.9:1.7: “ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kimaṅgaṃ [kimaṅga (sī.)] panāhan”ti?
segments.sn20.9:2.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn20.9:2.2: “idha, bhante, aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
segments.sn20.9:2.6: ‘ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kimaṅgaṃ panāhan’”ti.
segments.sn20.9:3.3: Te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā [abbhūhetvā (ka.), abbāhitvā (mahāva.278)] suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā [saṅkharitvā (pī. ka.)] ajjhoharanti.
segments.sn20.9:3.4: Tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca, na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.9:3.5: Tesaṃyeva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
segments.sn20.9:3.6: Tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya.
segments.sn20.9:3.7: Tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.9:4.1: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idha therā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti.
segments.sn20.9:4.4: Te taṃ lābhaṃ agadhitā amucchitā anajjhopannā [anajjhāpannā (sabbattha) ma. ni.1 pāsarāsisuttavaṇṇanā oloketabbā] ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
segments.sn20.9:4.5: Tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca, na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.9:4.6: Tesaṃyeva kho pana, bhikkhave, therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anusikkhamānā navā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti.
segments.sn20.9:4.9: Te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
segments.sn20.9:4.10: Tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya, te tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn20.9:4.12: ‘agadhitā amucchitā anajjhopannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā taṃ lābhaṃ paribhuñjissāmā’ti.

lines: Kimaṅgaṃ panāhanti ahaṃ pana kiṃkāraṇā na upasaṅkamissāmi?
Te kira abhiṇhaṃ bhiṅkārasaddaṃ karonti, tasmā bhiṅkacchāpāti vuccanti.
Pasannākāraṃ karontīti pasannehi kattabbākāraṃ karonti, cattāro paccaye denti.
Dhammaṃ bhāsantīti ekaṃ dve jātakāni vā suttante vā uggaṇhitvā asambhinnena sarena dhammaṃ desenti.
Pasannākāraṃ karontīti tesaṃ tāya desanāya pasannā gihī paccaye denti.
Neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāyāti neva guṇavaṇṇāya, na ñāṇabalāya hoti, guṇavaṇṇe pana parihāyante sarīravaṇṇopi sarīrabalampi parihāyati, tasmā sarīrassa neva vaṇṇāya na balāya hoti.
Asambhinnenāti sarasampattito asambhinnena, sarassa uccāraṇasampattiṃ aparihāpetvāti attho.
Tanti taṃ tathā paccayānaṃ paribhuñjanaṃ, taṃ tathā micchāpaṭipajjanaṃ.
Padhānānuyuñjanavelāya nivedanavasena tattha tattha ekajjhaṃ pahataghaṇḍinigghoseneva ekaghaṇḍinigghoso, tattha tattha paṇṇasālādīsu vasantānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasena ekapadhānabhūto.
Nānāmukhoti anurādhapurassa pacchimadisāyaṃ eko vihāro, pilicchikoḷi nagarassa puratthimadisāyaṃ.
